findings.fix:
Replace lines 1016-1033 with the text below. I ran the same pipeline with other temporary file names: 250 names found, 0 without a row, 0 names with two rows.
"These commands print the names that the code reads and that have no row. They
cover C, C++, Rust, Python, shell and `GNUmakefile`. Run them in the root of
the repository.

```bash
export LC_ALL=C
grep -oE '^\| `[^`]+`' README.environment.md | tr -d '|` ' | sort -u > /tmp/env-rows.txt
{
  # C and C++
  git grep -IhoE '(secure_)?getenv *\( *"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*"' -- '*.cpp' '*.hpp' '*.c' '*.h'
  # Rust
  git grep -IhoE '(env::var(_os)?|env!)\( *"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*"' -- '*.rs'
  # Python, including scripts without a file extension
  git grep -IhoE '(os\.environ(\.get|\.pop|\.setdefault)?[[(]|os\.getenv\() *"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*"' -- '*.py' bin perfetto
} | grep -oE '"[^"]+"' | tr -d '"' | sort -u > /tmp/env-names.txt
# Shell and Make: variables with a default or a required value
git grep -IhoE '\$\{[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*:?[-=?+]' -- '*.sh' bin GNUmakefile .github \
  | grep -oE '[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*' >> /tmp/env-names.txt
# Names without a row. No output means that no row is missing.
sort -u /tmp/env-names.txt | comm -23 - /tmp/env-rows.txt
# Names with more than one row. No output means that each name has one row.
grep -oE '^\| `[^`]+`' README.environment.md | sort | uniq -d
```

The commands do not cover everything. They miss a name that reaches the read
through a helper function, a constant or a table. Python scripts often hold
the name in a constant such as `DICE_GRANT_ID_ENV`. They also do not look at
workflow `env:` blocks, CMake `$ENV{...}`, Nix attributes, make `?=` defaults
or variables that Tron sets for a child process. Search for those by hand."

notes:
Short version. No CI check or Git hook fails on the staged change. One claim needs an owner before the merge: the label Operators tells support engineers that they may set 42 variables on deployed systems. The other findings are about text that goes stale, rules that the file does not follow itself, and the file size, which is at 88.6% of a GitHub search limit.

Words used here. lint-toolchain: the Nix check that the CI job Lint builds (flake.nix:2265-2449). lefthook: the Git hook runner that lefthook.yml configures. lint-agent-guidance: bin/ci/lint-agent-guidance.py, which checks the AGENTS.md files and their relative links. lint-notes: the check of "Note [Title]" cross-references. Fragment: one file under changelog.d/. KiB: 1,024 bytes. Row: one table line that starts with a variable name.

Check 1, claims. "Each variable has exactly one row" is true: 529 rows in the 7 numbered sections, 529 distinct names, 0 duplicates. "Set by (sections 2, 3, 5 and 6)" and "For (section 1 only)" match the table headers. All 56 relative links and anchors of the three files resolve (README.environment.md 19, AGENTS.md 18, README.md 19). All 255 file paths in code spans exist, apart from 11 generated or virtual-environment paths. The file holds 0 line-number references, as its rule 4 demands. The SYSTEM_CONFIG row agrees with README.md:589 on which side wins.

Check 2, stale text. Acceptable history: the commit id and date in lines 1012-1014, and the example id `sub-2026-11-21-003` in the DICE_GRANT_ID row (bin/dice:3396 builds that form). Wrong after the next unrelated merge: the 44 "and N more" counts, the 29 sentences that count workflows, jobs, tests, scripts, steps or files, the 5 rows with pinned versions, the 149 quoted strings and the 34 sentences about source comments. The file holds no pull request reference of its own. The one "#3087" is part of a quoted step name.

Check 3, scope. The change touches 3 files and nothing else: 1,033 new lines, 3 lines in README.md, 3 lines in AGENTS.md. It leaves the older tables alone, for example "## Environment variables" in README.proxy.md:274. Those tables and this file now describe the same variables in two places.

Check 4, CI. I ran no repository script. I read their source and ran only git, grep and my own scripts. (a) Whitespace check of lint-toolchain (flake.nix:2303-2309) and the lefthook hook `whitespace`: pass. `git diff --check --cached` against the empty tree printed nothing for the three files, exit code 0. (b) lint-agent-guidance (flake.nix:2441, lefthook hook `agent-guidance`, glob **/AGENTS.md): pass. The new link target README.environment.md exists in the staged tree. The check fails only if AGENTS.md is committed without the new file. (c) bin/ci/test-lint-agent-guidance.py builds its own temporary tree and reads none of the three files. (d) lint-notes reads doc/*.md (GNUmakefile:41), not root README files. README.environment.md holds 0 "Note [" strings. (e) bin/ci/lint-ci-pins.sh and bin/ci/check-lock-freshness.sh do not read Markdown. (f) The repository has no Markdown lint, no link check and no spelling check. .editorconfig is met: LF line ends, final newline, no trailing space, no tabs, ASCII only. (g) The table structure is sound: every row has the cell count of its header, no code span holds a pipe, no angle-bracket text sits outside a code span. (h) Workflows with path filters (nix-build, ingest-coverage, slice, prime-hf-models, positron-dice-deb) do not start for these files. gcp-nix.yml and deb-smoke.yml have no path filter. On a draft pull request gcp-nix.yml runs Lint, CI machinery tests and Fresh Cabal plan (README.ci.md:92 lists the required checks). (i) nix/cmake-tron-source.nix:5-8 removes every .md file from the Tron build inputs, so the new file does not change the build identity.
